prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed visual layout for pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen with an immersive full-bleed layout showcasing pet options visually.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet care instructions screen before photo upload: Insert a photo setup guide screen before custom pet creation to ensure upload success.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_pet_care_guide", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_care_guide": {"headline": "Photo Setup Guide", "body": "Follow these simple photo guidelines for the highest quality custom pet creation.", "layout": "card"}}
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop companion quick start checklist flow: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist layout for desktop pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Learn desktop companion shortcuts", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for sign in screen: Redesign the sign-in screen using a focused spotlight layout to emphasize safe account restoration.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop progress timer notification on waiting screen: Show dynamic time estimate and ready notifications while waiting for pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Clear onboarding path selection headline copy: Update the choose path headline and body text to clearly explain fast catalog vs custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey", "body": "Select a ready companion or generate your custom desktop pet in minutes."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption certificate seal badge: Add a verified companion digital seal badge component to the adoption certificate.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Verified Companion Certificate", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet interaction hint on home intro: Add an actionable hint component to home intro explaining how to control and speak to the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open quick controls and talk."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Two column layout for choose path screen: Format the path selection screen with a side-by-side two column layout.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column"}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Pet restore account sign-in hint: Add a hint to the sign-in screen informing users that logging in restores their existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously adopted pets."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen layout is an allowed onboarding change.
Adding a new setup guide screen inside onboarding without removing required steps is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro layout and adding components within onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout within onboarding is allowed.
Adding real wait time estimates and notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.
Updating copy on the choose path screen while retaining both path options is allowed.
Adding a digital seal badge component to the adoption certificate is permitted.
Adding a helpful interaction hint component to the home intro screen is allowed.
Changing the layout of the choose path screen within onboarding is allowed.
Adding account restoration copy to the sign-in screen within onboarding is allowed.
